title: a namespace mapped to a non-object is a fatal manifest violation
rationale: The §8.1 exception covers a non-object extensions field, not a non-object member value. That falls back to §5.2 and is fatal. The narrow exception is easy to widen by accident.
quote: The optional `extensions` field in `plugin.json` MUST be an object whose member names are client extension namespaces and whose member values are objects.
